bla_fear_neuron.note: No CL term found for BLA fear-conditioning glutamatergic principal neuron. Functional identity (CS-responsive, projects to mPFC) not represented in CL. Potential CL contribution as a subtype of glutamatergic neuron or BLA principal neuron.

bla_extinction_neuron.note: No CL term found for BLA extinction (Fear-Off) glutamatergic neuron. Ntsr2/Dkk3/Rspo2 molecular identity and mPFC reciprocal connectivity not represented in CL. Potential CL contribution as functionally distinct BLA principal neuron subtype.

bla_npy_neurogliaform_interneuron.label: NPY interneuron
bla_npy_neurogliaform_interneuron.note: CL:4072016 (NPY interneuron) captures NPY expression and GABAergic interneuron identity but does not specify neurogliaform morphology or amygdala location. CL:0000693 (neurogliaform cell) captures the morphological class but does not specify NPY expression or amygdala location. The combined identity (NPY-expressing neurogliaform in BLA) has no dedicated CL term. CL:4072016 chosen as primary BROAD match on molecular marker; CL:0000693 noted as morphological BROAD alternative.

alternative_matches.label: neurogliaform cell
alternative_matches.note: Morphological class match — neurogliaform soma/dendrite/axon pattern; not NPY-specific or amygdala-specific.

bla_calbindin_dendrite_targeting_interne.note: No CL term found for calbindin-positive dendrite-targeting GABAergic interneuron in BLA. Calbindin interneurons not represented as a named class in CL (searches for calbindin interneuron, CB1 dendrite-targeting, and related terms all returned no hits). Potential CL contribution.

cea_large_aspiny_neuron.note: No CL term found for CeA large aspiny GABAergic neuron. Central amygdala neurons are not represented as named classes in CL. Aspiny GABAergic projection neurons of the CeA (large subtype) lack a dedicated CL term. Potential CL contribution.

cea_small_aspiny_neuron.note: No CL term found for CeA small aspiny GABAergic neuron. Central amygdala neurons are not represented as named classes in CL. Aspiny GABAergic projection neurons of the CeA (small subtype) lack a dedicated CL term. Potential CL contribution.

pl_immature_excitatory_neuron.label: immature neuron
pl_immature_excitatory_neuron.note: CL:4042028 (immature neuron) captures the developmental immaturity and CNS location. However, it does not specify glutamatergic/excitatory identity, amygdaloid paralaminar nucleus location, or the protracted postnatal maturation timeline characteristic of this type. CL:4042029 (cortical immature neuron) is a closer developmental parallel but explicitly cortex-specific and therefore less appropriate for a paralaminar nucleus cell. BROAD match to CL:4042028 on developmental state; amygdala-specific immature excitatory neuron class absent from CL. Potential CL contribution.

alternative_matches.label: cortical immature neuron
alternative_matches.note: Developmental profile (prenatal origin, persists immature through lifespan) is analogous, but term is explicitly cortex-restricted and not applicable to paralaminar nucleus.
